title: Text: DET Nick Castellanos ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Yo, sorry I didn’t get back to you. It’s been a shit storm
I trust you but its a long story. My editors are putting something out there soon about the situation
You don’t have to tell me if it’s a big deal was just curious because on the surface that looks like a childish thing to do

You know him and what he’s about. Unfortunate it had to come to this. I try hard to build relationships with players like I have with you and many others (seriously) and it’s bullshit he throws stuff out there like this to discredit my name, especially with the players
Quite frankly dude, calling a journalist unethical is like me accusing him of taking PEDs

It’s like all we go on, you know...but I ain’t got 2 million twitter followers to punch back with and we don’t try to make ourselves part of the story. It’s been uncomfortable but I think people will see the bigger picture soon
I’m gonna get them to send me your way later in the season, I’ll talk to you more then. Please this to yourself
And keep killing it, man. I’m really happy for you. Appreciate you reaching out 👊
